description: Use before sending a token to someone. Token transfers go to the recipient's token account, not their wallet; models cannot derive this address in their heads. Derives the associated token account (ATA) for a wallet and mint using the mint's real token program, checks whether it exists, and prices creating it if not. Inputs: wallet: The owner of the token account (usually the recipient). mint: The token's mint address. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: Free (rate-limited). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/find_ata.
name: find_ata
